primary_cause_name: Distribution shift (synthetic vs real data mismatch)
detailed_reasons: Training data is 100% SYNTHETIC with 192.168.x.x IPs and synthetic patterns. Localhost is 100% REAL_DB with 127.0.0.1 IPs and real operational patterns. The VAE learned to reconstruct synthetic distributions, not real ones.
Model capacity is adequate (converged, no overfitting).

A_encoding_mismatch.reason: V6 encoding is consistent between train and localhost (both Internal, both has_telemetry=1). The encoding itself is not the problem.

B_distribution_shift.reason: Training data is 100% SYNTHETIC with 192.168.x.x IPs. Localhost is 100% REAL_DB with 127.0.0.1 IPs. The VAE learned synthetic patterns that do not generalize to real operational data.

C_model_capacity.reason: Model converged (train loss=0.011038), no overfitting (val/train ratio=0.55). Architecture 9-64-32-8-32-64-9 is adequate for the task.

D_training_objective.reason: KL/reconstruction ratio=401.6672 (balanced). Beta=0.001 is appropriate. Training objective is not the issue.
